_comment: Composer overlay merged into app/composer.json inside the ephpm-worker image only.
The other runtime images are untouched and keep the shared composer.json/composer.lock.
ephpm packages are distributed via their GitHub repositories, not Packagist.
They are declared here as inline 'package' repositories rather than 'vcs'
repositories for one specific reason: ephpm/octane-driver v0.1.1 declares
while this benchmark app is pinned to laravel/framework v13.25.0 and
symfony/http-foundation v8.1.4. A plain 'vcs' require would be refused by the
solver. The inline definitions below therefore omit those two framework
constraints and keep only the dependency that actually has to resolve
(ephpm/worker). The driver's own code is used unmodified, straight from the
v0.1.1 tag. This relaxation is a benchmark-harness decision and is recorded in
RESULTS-EPHPM.md; it is not an upstream compatibility claim.
